components.name: Foundation / Runtime
components.isolationReason: Shares one BuilderKernel execution with python-git/applications/cutover-runtime; the real installer dispatches all four through a single Invoke-KIStackBuilderKernel.ps1 run, never per-component.

components.name: Python / Git
components.isolationReason: Same single BuilderKernel execution unit as foundation-runtime/applications/cutover-runtime.

components.name: ComfyUI
components.isolationReason: Self-contained own entry script and rollback (Invoke-KIStackComfyUI.ps1); the isolated executor re-checks Test-KICompleteComfyUICompliant immediately before any mutation, so an existing, supported, newer installation (e.g. v0.34.0) is preserved and never reset to the v0.28.0 Greenfield reference payload.

components.name: Visual Models / Workflows
components.isolationReason: Self-contained own entry script (Import-KIStackExternalModels.ps1); only ever writes into the model/workflow manifest area, never reconciles ComfyUI itself.

components.name: Applications
components.isolationReason: Same single BuilderKernel execution unit as foundation-runtime/python-git/cutover-runtime.

components.name: Integration
components.isolationReason: Self-contained own entry script (Invoke-KIStackIntegration.ps1); its own Install-IntegrationRuntime now folds an already-applied RAG embedding-prefix starter line forward instead of blindly overwriting it (Merge-IntegrationOpenWebUIWithSearchStarterContent), so it is safe as a genuinely isolated route.

components.name: Cutover Runtime
components.isolationReason: This IS the BuilderKernel execution unit that foundation-runtime/python-git/applications share; not a separable component.

components.name: Production Recovery
components.isolationReason: No independent installation code path exists at all (installable:false, pinned reference only; falls through to the generic non-installable-reference marker).

components.name: Validation Gate
components.isolationReason: Self-contained public installer with its own backup/restore; never touches any other component's runtime files.

components.name: Target Acceptance
components.isolationReason: No independent installation code path exists at all (installable:false, pinned reference only).

components.name: OpenWebUI Visual Pack
components.isolationReason: Self-contained public installer script with its own backup/rollback; requires OpenWebUI reachable plus an admin API token (runtime precondition, not a COMPONENTS.json dependency).

components.name: OpenWebUI Agent Pack
components.isolationReason: Self-contained Install-OpenWebUIAgentPack/Test-OpenWebUIAgentPack with their own transactional backup/rollback contract; optionally reads Visual Pack's registered tool ids but degrades gracefully if unavailable (soft, not hard).

components.name: OpenWebUI Ballistics
components.isolationReason: Self-contained Install-OpenWebUIBallisticsPack with its own backup directory contract.

components.name: Codex Local
components.isolationReason: Self-contained Invoke-KIStackCodexLocal.ps1 with its own Install/Validate/Rollback actions.

components.name: RAG
components.isolationReason: Self-contained Install-KICompleteRAGModule with its own BackupRoot contract (redeploys module files/env wiring only; never triggers ingestion, which remains a separate, manual, user-controlled action) -- but it reads and rewrites modules/integration/Start-KIStack-OpenWebUI-WithSearch.cmd and throws if that file is missing, so Integration must already be present on the target.
